governor's.linePrev: I'd set my dog before a hoop and say, "Now boy, now boy!"
governor's.lineNext: The state bird falls from its branch
stanza: The state bird falls from its branch
Meanwhile, back home at the ranch
I still get up early in the morning
And I never knew a better place

governor's.linePrev: The years ran as if for their lives
governor's.line: I, the shameless beau of a governor’s wife—
stanza: The years ran as if for their lives
I, the shameless beau of a governor’s wife—
Holding hats and coats and shoes…
Then running guns for a lost decade
I pushed pins in maps to show
How to stop a plague or make it go;
And then they took me out in chains
When a secret shared had changed the game
